extension.summary: Fast front end for your Netflix add-on
extension.description: SmoothFlix is a Kodi front end for the Netflix add-on. Home and lists stay in SmoothFlix, listings are cached, and artwork is left for Kodi to load. Playback is handed to plugin.video.netflix, which plays through your own account with inputstream.adaptive. SmoothFlix does not sign in, request licenses, or supply streams.
extension.disclaimer: Requires the Netflix add-on (plugin.video.netflix) and your own account. Video plays only through that add-on and Kodi inputstream.adaptive.
extension.news: v0.1.0 (2026-11-19)[CR]- First release of the SmoothFlix front end.

extension.description: Official repository for the SmoothFlix add-on. Install this once from a zip file, then install SmoothFlix from Kodi's add-on browser. Updates are published from this repository.
